messages:
marie: Quick ask — after yesterday's GA, proposing a tiny follow-up sprint: 2 high-impact bugs + 1 low-risk enhancement. Keep it a single micro-release or stagger?
alex: Sounds reasonable. Which bugs are we calling high-impact?
sam: The top two are: 1) widget crash on long prompts (customer-facing) 2) rate-limiter bypass on heavy syncs (seen in telemetry). Both cause user pain.
marie: Agreed. Crash is priority #1. Rate-limiter is #2. Enhancement is the "suggested prompt" microcopy for onboarding. Low risk.
tina: If the crash is >24h to fix, we should ship the enhancement earlier — it reduces support load.
sam: I can get the crash patch in ~18h if we freeze non-critical merges to api and runtime. Need a quick CI harness tweak.
marie: Plan: canary the crash-only release first, validate, then include rate-limiter and the microcopy in the next micro release. That reduces blast radius. :thumbsup: 
alex: +1 for canary. Also add a post-deploy smoke that hits long prompts.
sam: Will add an automated smoke job and a short repro test. tagging @deploy-bot to run canary when ready.
deploy-bot: Canary pipeline started: canary/1798312345-1 (will post results in #eng-runtime)
marie: Thanks — assigning owners: sam (crash), alex (rate-limiter), tina (enhancement UX). I'll label the backlog item: patch/critical, sprint/micro-1. Quick sync 13:00 today to lock scope.
